The baggage allowance for Bengaluru (BLR) to London (LON) flights depends on the specific ticket and class of service purchased. You can check the baggage allowance printed on your ticket or confirmed in your booking details. However, be aware that **the baggage allowance printed on the ticket may not always match the actual applicable allowance**. In case of discrepancies or underpayment for baggage, Air India may issue an **Agency Debit Memo (ADM)** to recover applicable charges, based on general excess baggage rates.

To confirm the exact baggage policy for your flight and avoid any confusion, it’s recommended that you verify the details through Air India’s official website, contact their customer service, or review the General Booking Policies regarding baggage.
